metadata.title: Families of knots that cannot be made Legendrian parametrically
metadata.abstract: The fact that every smooth knot type admits a Legendrian representative is a classical result in contact topology. However, the analogous surjectivity question was open at the parametric level. In this work we address the $n>1$ case. We prove that for every $n\geq 3$, every knot type $\mathcal K$, every Legendrian representative $\mathcal L$ and every formal Legendrian representative $\mathcal{FL}$, the associated group homomorphisms $\pi_n(\mathcal{L})\to\pi_n(\mathcal{K})$ and $\pi_n(\mathcal{FL})\to\pi_n(\mathcal{K})$ are never surjective. We then show that surjectivity at the $\pi_2$-level depends on the knot type. This work thus proves the presence of rigidity for parametric families at every higher homotopy level beyond $\pi_1$.
metadata.comment: The results of this article appeared in preliminary form in version 1 of arXiv:2406.04293 . The project was later split and these results no longer appeared in version 2 of arXiv:2406.04293 . This article presents an improved and expanded version of those results

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 证明任意结型的 Legendrian 或形式 Legendrian 代表空间到光滑结空间的高阶同伦映射在 n≥3 时均不满射，并说明 π₂ 满射性依结型而变。
analysis.breakthrough: 区分单个结可 Legendrian 化与参数族可同时实现的差异，给出高阶刚性。
analysis.limitations: 不涉及已经排除的 π₁ 情形；作者注明部分结果曾出现在另一预印本初版，不能全部记为首次公开。 数学分析仅依据摘要和评论，未审读完整证明。 AI 披露另见独立全文检索及命中核查记录；未见披露不代表未使用 AI。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 ChatGPT 5.6 用于校对、识别错误、笔误和需要澄清处；没有据此推断其生成核心证明。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.18492v1 · PDF第9页，Use of AI tools

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者披露 ChatGPT 5.6 用于校对、识别错误、笔误和需要澄清处；没有据此推断其生成核心证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 接触几何中结构性障碍清晰，但与本组曲率主线较间接。
